title.zh: 从 Wire Bond 到Flip Chip：
title.en: From Wire Bond to Flip Chip:

subtitle.en: Connections move onto the chip surface

body.zh: 芯片封装连接技术演进
body.en: Chip packaging Evolution of interconnection technology

body.zh: 更高的I/O密度更短的电气路径面向下一代芯片
body.en: Higher I/O density Shorter electrical paths For next-generation chips

body.zh: 金属线芯片边缘焊盘封装I/O
body.en: Metal wire Chip Peripheral pad Package I/O

body.zh: 当需求上升I/O数增加信号频率提高供电电流增大
body.en: As demands increase More I/Os Higher signal frequency Higher supply current

body.zh: 开始占用系统余量导线长度寄生电感封装高度
body.en: System margins begin to be consumed Wire length Parasitic inductance Package height

body.zh: Flip Chip连接走向芯片表面缩短路径并提高连接密度
body.en: Flip Chip Connections move onto the chip surface Shorter paths and higher connection density

body.zh: 芯片凸点底填封装基板I/O
body.en: Chip Bump Underfill Package substrate I/O

body.zh: 带来制造挑战凸点底填翘曲装配控制
body.en: Manufacturing challenges Bumps Underfill Warpage Assembly control

body.zh: 需要结合具体芯片尺寸、焊点几何、材料配方和工艺节拍来验证
body.en: Validation must account for the particular chip dimensions, joint geometry, material formulation and process cadence

body.zh: 不能脱离封装结构单独推广
body.en: Results cannot be generalized independently of the package structure
